headline: Curve un-inverted (bull-steepening)
detail: The yield curve dis-inverted after a prior inversion. Historically the re-steepening — not the inversion — is the late-cycle handoff: recessions have begun ~13 months (range ~8–19) after the curve re-steepens, and a bull-steepening un-inversion (short rates falling, cuts priced) is the ominous one.
headline_zh: 曲线解除倒挂（牛市陡峭）
detail_zh: 收益率曲线在此前倒挂后解除。历史上是重新陡峭（而非倒挂本身）作为周期晚段交接：衰退在曲线重新陡峭后约13个月（区间约8–19个月）开始，且牛市陡峭式解除（短端利率下行、定价降息）最为不祥。
